description: This file defines the 'OutsideRuntimeClient' class, which implements core client-side runtime functionalities for Orleans, including message handling, connection management, callback tracking, and lifecycle control.

classes.name: OutsideRuntimeClient
classes.description: A partial class implementing Orleans client runtime functionalities, including message processing, lifecycle management, and connection handling.

methods.name: ConsumeServices
methods.description: Initializes dependencies and services required for the client runtime, including setting up callbacks and starting background tasks.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the client, establishing connections and initializing message centers.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the client, disposing resources and stopping background tasks.

methods.name: StartInternal
methods.description: Performs internal startup routines, including establishing gateway connections and message center initialization.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages based on their direction, dispatching responses or requests accordingly.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message corresponding to a received request.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message to a target grain, setting up callbacks and message properties.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming response messages, updating callbacks or triggering cancellations.

methods.name: UnregisterCallback
methods.description: Removes a callback from the tracking dictionary based on message ID.

methods.name: ConstructorReset
methods.description: Resets the client state by disposing resources.

methods.name: GetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current response timeout setting.

methods.name: SetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Updates the response timeout setting.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference for a given object, registering it as a client observer if applicable.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Removes a grain reference associated with a local object.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the client, releasing resources and stopping background tasks.

methods.name: BreakOutstandingMessagesToSilo
methods.description: Marks messages targeting a dead silo as failed.

methods.name: GetRunningRequestsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active requests for a specific grain interface type.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies observers that the cluster connection has been lost.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of changes in the number of gateways.

methods.name: MonitorCallbackExpiry
methods.description: Background task that periodically checks for expired callbacks and triggers timeouts.

methods.name: ThrowIfDisposed
methods.description: Throws an exception if the client has been disposed.
